observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with two white DualSense controllers placed on top.
A black tablet is also visible, likely a PlayStation Vita or similar device, with a white DualSense controller resting on it.
The console has the PlayStation logo on the top left and a red light on the controller's analog stick.
The controllers have the PlayStation logo and standard button layout.
The console appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.

identity.kind: PlayStation 5 Slim console with 2 controllers and 12 games

claims.claim: Still Clean like New PlayStation 5 slim

Photo 0 clearly shows two white DualSense controllers on top of the console.
No games are visible in the photo. The claim cannot be verified from the image alone. The games may be digital or physical, but their presence and condition are not shown.

risks.risk: The console may not be a genuine PlayStation 5 Slim or may be a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's model label or serial number, or a video showing the console booting up and displaying the PS5 logo.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic console, not a PS5 Slim, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The '12 latest games' may not be included or may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the games in their cases or on the console's library screen, or a video of the games being played.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having no games, or as games not included, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The tablet may be a third-party device or not compatible with the console.
risks.proof: A photo of the tablet's screen showing the PS5 logo or a video of it connecting to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional or incompatible device, reducing value.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's model label or serial number.
Photo or video of the games on the console or in their cases.
Photo or video of the tablet connected to the console and showing the PS5 logo.
Video of the console booting up and displaying the PS5 interface.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
